cues: In the leaf, water evaporates from the wet walls of the mesophyll cells and diffuses out through the stomata.
Each evaporating surface tugs on the water behind it, and that tug reaches all the way down the xylem.
text: Pillar one: transpiration pull. In the leaf, water evaporates from the wet walls of the mesophyll cells and diffuses out through the stomata. Each evaporating surface tugs on the water behind it, and that tug reaches all the way down the xylem.
